summary: Deliver one additive identity-administration contract across OSS and Enterprise: shared schemas first, then OSS D1/SQLite/API/Console/CLI, Enterprise PostgreSQL/Node/SMTP/RLS/SCIM, followed by privacy, isolation, migration, and compatibility gates.
decision_refs: all schema changes are additive and existing principals remain stable
tenant provisioning is excluded from general administration
tenant role is singular while project roles may be multiple
full_name is field-level private and excluded from audit metadata
email and SCIM are initially feature-flagged off
residual_risks: External package and image publication is outside the authorized local implementation.
Live SMTP, OIDC-provider, and Okta SCIM acceptance require configured deployment credentials.
